_notes.method: Commons searched (CirrusSearch, filew:>1599, structured-data CC0/PD statements; category browsing for New Orleans) and screened by eye on contact sheets. Each candidate's licence, author and size are read from the same imageinfo/extmetadata query city_images.imageinfo() sends, and cleared by city_images.clear_licence() plus the review's refused-file list (REVIEW_REFUSED): all 36 pass. local_file is Wikimedia's own 1600 px rendition (the pipeline's image_url), relative to atlas/. Every candidate is public domain or CC0; no CC BY fallback was needed. Each local file was looked at for: street level, daylight, close identifiable faces, recent US sculpture/mural as subject, government emblem.
